title: Outbound webhook event (v1)
description: JSON payload POSTed by the omp-bundler core to an adapter's registered callback URL. The adapter is the consumer and acknowledges each POST. Adapter identity is supplied by the route (/v1/adapters/{adapterId}/...); it is not duplicated here. conversationKey is opaque and stable within the adapter namespace.

adapterApiVersion.description: API contract version; always the literal "v1".

sequence.description: Positive integer, monotonically increasing per correlationId.

occurredAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp ending in Z, marking event generation (advisory).

path.description: Workspace-relative POSIX path to the attachment. Never inline bytes; the adapter enforces path safety at read time.

name.description: Optional display name for the attachment.

mediaType.description: Optional IANA media type of the attachment payload.

cacheRead.description: Nonnegative integer. Cached prompt tokens read.

cacheWrite.description: Nonnegative integer. Prompt tokens written to cache.

costUsd.description: Nonnegative numeric cost in USD for the turn. May be fractional.

oneOf.title: turn.started
oneOf.description: A turn begins for a correlation. Delivered at-least-once. Always precedes turn.reply or turn.error for the same correlationId in a gap-free delivery.

oneOf.title: turn.progress
oneOf.description: Best-effort progress notification carrying a human-readable message. May be dropped or coalesce; a drop creates a sequence gap that the adapter MUST tolerate. Never terminal.

message.description: Human-readable progress text, suitable for direct display.

oneOf.title: turn.reply
oneOf.description: Terminal event carrying the completed turn reply. Delivered at-least-once. Attachments are workspace-relative POSIX paths; bytes are never inlined. Its arrival closes the turn regardless of dropped progress. Both text and attachments are always present; the pair (empty text, empty attachments) is invalid.

allOf.description: Reject a reply where text is empty and attachments is empty.

text.description: Reply text. May be empty only when attachments is non-empty.

attachments.description: Workspace-relative output attachments. May be empty only when text is non-empty.

oneOf.title: presence.changed
oneOf.description: Presence change of the core agent within a conversation. Delivered at-least-once.

presence.description: New presence state of the core agent.

oneOf.title: turn.error
oneOf.description: Terminal error for a correlation. Delivered at-least-once. Its arrival closes the turn; the adapter MUST NOT expect a subsequent turn.reply for the same correlationId.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable error code. Not localized.

message.description: Curated, human-readable error message suitable for display.

retryable.description: Whether the core failure is transient. Reports the nature of the failure, not permission to replay an already-accepted inbound message; a new inbound request is required to retry.
